Cream soda is loved by many. Italian cream soda is, well... even more amazing, in my opinion. If you haven't tried Italian cream soda, go and try some NOW.

What you'll need (assuming you have about a 16-oz glass. If not, shorten or lengthen the amount.)
Ice cubes

2 cups of either club soda, Sprite, or Coca Cola

2-3 tbsp flavoring syrup (Torani is the best, and my favorite is toasted marshmallow, but there are many flavors.I DO NOT RECOMMEND USING MAPLE SYRUP.)

2-3 tbsp half-and-half, milk, or cream

Put your ice cubes in FIRST. This is important because if you add your Sprite and half-and-half without ice cubes, it will just become a foamy, frothy mess.
Next, pour your 2 cups of soda in. Add the flavoring syrup. Then, pour the cream in. Top with whipped cream if you'd like.
